ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity black pixels with localized high-intensity white/grey clusters on distal regions; estimated macro-level white-to-black ratio is approximately 0.15:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast mottled white/grey patch located at the outer distal tip of the right lobe; series of concentric white linear arcs on the mid-section of the left lobe; sparse white punctate distribution across the lower mid-ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with a sharp vertex; estimated angle of 45 degrees between lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, irregular jagged peaks at the distal right tip; moderate-frequency serrations along the remaining trailing edge boundaries of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve sweeping from the median notch toward the distal tips, with a sharp upward trajectory at the outer extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed cluster of roughly circular high-contrast spots on the right distal lobe; isolated white circular clusters on the inner right lobe near the fluke center.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 4-5 distinct, parallel, concentric curved white lines situated on the outer mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced jagged, irregular tissue loss and heavy scarring at the distal tip of the right lobe, creating a non-uniform terminal edge compared to the left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly structured, parallel linear pigmentation pattern on the left lobe, distinct from typical random mottling.
